capture_deletes.description: Whether to capture document deletions from Firestore. Set to false to disable delete capture, which may improve connector performance. Default value: true.

packed_mode_tables.description: Specific tables to sync. Must be populated if `packing_mode` is set to `SelectTablesForPackedMode`.

packing_mode.description: Whether to sync all tables in unpacked mode or specific tables in packed mode. Default value: `UseUnpackedModeOnly`.

service_account_key.description: The contents of your service account key file. Required for authentication.

sub_collections.description: List of nested collections to sync. Only specified subCollections can be synced.
